text:
maria: Heads up — deploybot alerted: canary publish for redwood/api:canary-20260321 partially failed in eu-west-1. ECR push succeeded but mirror provenance missing platform annotation, causing digest mismatch.

deploy-bot: [automated] publish halted for region eu-west-1, flagged attestation mismatch: missing "platform" label. See /deploy/logs/6350001122

sam: Is this the same symptom as the last canary mirror drift? If it's just missing annotation we could retag and push again with cosign annotation.

anjali: Can we confirm if the artifact in us-east-1 has a valid attestation? I can check.

ci-bot: checked: us-east-1 digest sha256:abcd1234 has attestation with platform=linux/amd64. eu-west-1 mirror shows digest sha256:abcd5678 and attestation payload lacks platform field.

maria: That suggests the mirror step stripped the annotation. Rollback or manual republish? We should avoid forcing canary straight through without provenance parity.

ops-oncall: If we rollback, canaries will revert to previous digest sha256:prev999 — that's low risk for traffic. But we need to coordinate release notes and a change window for manual republish.

sam: I can do a manual republish with cosign and explicit --payload-file to inject platform. Command I'll run if we go that route:

```
# retag and push
docker pull registry.redwood.dev/redwood/api@sha256:abcd1234
docker tag registry.redwood.dev/redwood/api@sha256:abcd1234 registry.redwood.dev/redwood/api:canary-20260321-republish
docker push registry.redwood.dev/redwood/api:canary-20260321-republish
# sign and annotate
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign --annotations platform=linux/amd64 registry.redwood.dev/redwood/api:canary-20260321-republish
```

anjali: If we republish we must update the canary release note and add a short blurb in the changelog about republish due to mirrored annotation loss.

release-manager: Prefer rollback + scheduled republish. Rollback now, schedule republish in the 15:00 UTC change window, update release notes and ping customers who watched the canary because it touches infra.

maria: Agreed. sam/anjali - can you split tasks? sam runs the republish in change window, anjali drafts release note and adds follow-up tasks.

sam: Ack. I'll prepare the republish script and test in staging. Will post logs here.

anjali: I'll add a short note: "Canary republished at [time] to restore provenance platform annotation after mirror step stripped metadata; no functional changes." Put it in the release notes and PROD/Canary channel.

deploy-bot: [automated] action queued: hold further canary rollouts for redwood/api until manual override by @maria. Reason: provenance mismatch.

ops-oncall: I'm adding a brief postmortem tag and creating an incident tracker ticket IT-2026-511.

maria: Rolling back canary now to sha256:prev999. I'll mark the deploybot hold and schedule 15:00 UTC republish. If anything changes ping @ops-oncall.

sam: Rollback complete, canary traffic back to prev digest. I'll validate metrics and post a short verification in ~5m.

anjali: Release note drafted and pushed to /docs/release-notes/canary-20260321.md

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: ensure mirror step preserves cosign attestation payload. I'll open a follow-up task with eng-infra to harden mirror tooling.
